name: sci_edu
description: Science education research term extraction schema

fields.name: research_topic
fields.description: Main research topics or themes addressed in the study (e.g., conceptual change, scientific reasoning, inquiry-based learning).

fields.name: scientific_concepts
fields.description: Specific scientific concepts or disciplinary ideas investigated (e.g., evolution, photosynthesis, Newton's laws).

fields.name: inquiry_abilities
fields.description: Scientific inquiry abilities or practices emphasized (e.g., hypothesizing, data analysis, modeling).

fields.name: instructional_strategies
fields.description: Teaching strategies, interventions, or instructional approaches used (e.g., flipped classroom, scaffolding, collaborative learning).

fields.name: participant_group
fields.description: Primary participant group (e.g., elementary students, pre-service teachers, in-service teachers).

fields.name: educational_level
fields.description: Educational level of participants (e.g., K-12, undergraduate, graduate).

fields.name: assessment_type
fields.description: Types of assessments or outcome measures used (e.g., conceptual test, questionnaire, interview).

fields.name: keywords
fields.description: Additional domain-specific keywords not covered above.
